seed.subject: a deep-sea diver in a brass helmet and heavy canvas suit
seed.posture: standing square to the viewer, arms at its sides, boots planted

seed.materials: tarnished brass, rubberised canvas, dry wheat, leather straps

frames.alt: a deep-sea diver in a brass helmet and heavy canvas suit
frames.caption: A deep-sea diver in a brass helmet and heavy canvas suit. Standing square to the viewer, arms at its sides, boots planted. A wheat field in high summer, the crop up to its waist, no horizon. Flat overcast daylight, no shadows. Tarnished brass, rubberised canvas, dry wheat, leather straps.
frames.anomaly: The helmet's faceplate is dark and reflects nothing back.

frames.alt: a figure clad in a beige fabric jumpsuit and a golden brass deep-sea diving helmet
frames.caption: A figure clad in a beige fabric jumpsuit and a golden brass deep-sea diving helmet. Standing upright facing directly forward with arms hanging loosely at its sides. A field of tall, mature wheat extending to a flat horizon under a cloud-covered sky. Soft, diffused natural light from directly overhead with neutral tones. Brass, woven cloth, dark leather, and dried wheat stalks.
frames.anomaly: A metallic deep-sea diving helmet worn in a dry wheat field.

frames.alt: A figure dressed in a beige fabric jumpsuit, dark gloves, and a gold-colored metal helmet
frames.caption: A figure dressed in a beige fabric jumpsuit, dark gloves, and a gold-colored metal helmet. It stands straight upright with arms at its sides, facing directly toward the camera. An open field of tall, golden wheat under an overcast gray sky. Soft, diffused white light coming from directly overhead. Metal, woven cloth, leather, and dried plant stalks.
frames.anomaly: A spherical brass deep-sea diving helmet attached to a buttoned cloth jumpsuit in a wheat field.

frames.alt: a figure wearing a beige fabric jumpsuit, heavy black leather gauntlet gloves, and a gold-colored diving helmet with a black visor
frames.caption: A figure wearing a beige fabric jumpsuit, heavy black leather gauntlet gloves, and a gold-colored diving helmet with a black visor. Standing upright facing directly forward with arms hanging straight down at its sides. A field of tall, ripe wheat stretching to a flat horizon beneath an overcast gray sky. Soft, diffused overhead daylight creating minimal shading. Polished gold metal, beige woven fabric, black leather, and dry wheat stalks.
frames.anomaly: A gold deep-sea diving helmet worn on a figure standing in a wheat field.

frames.alt: a figure clad in a beige fabric outfit, long black gauntlets, and a gold metallic diving dome
frames.caption: A figure clad in a beige fabric outfit, long black gauntlets, and a gold metallic diving dome. Standing completely upright, facing directly toward the camera with hands lowered. A farm crop of golden grain stems under an overcast, pale sky. Diffused white light coming softly from above with minimal shading. Gold-toned metal, black rubber, beige textile, and dried grain stalks.
frames.anomaly: A vintage diving dome with a black circular window worn above a beige cloth top among dry agricultural crops.
